disease_state.evidence: we prepared protein extracts of LGs from a wild-type and an ADDE mouse model and analyzed the proteome by quantitative mass spectrometry.

sample_source.evidence: Frozen LGs from NOD (n = 6) and BALB/c (n = 6) mice were resuspended in lysis buffer (8 M urea, 75 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris-HCl [pH 8], 1 mM NaF, 1 mM β-glycerophosphate, 1 mM sodium orthovanadate, 10 mM sodium pyrophosphate, 1 mM PMSF, and 1 tablet of EDTA-free protease inhibitor cocktail) and homogenized using sonication.
